artifacts.name: RailStationShape
artifacts.description: A RailStation is located in exactly one Geospatial Location, has exactly one Designative Name and one Arbitrary Identifier, at most one Code Identifier, and any wheelchair boarding code is an integer 0-2.

artifacts.name: StationCoordinateShape
artifacts.description: A StationCoordinateRecord is about exactly one Geospatial Location and is carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with a single in-range decimal latitude and longitude.

artifacts.name: IdentifierShape
artifacts.description: Designative Names, Code Identifiers and Arbitrary Identifiers each designate exactly one entity and are carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with a single non-empty string text value.

artifacts.name: AgencyTimeZoneShape
artifacts.description: An Organization is designated by a Designative Name; a GTFSRecord uses exactly one Time Zone Identifier, which is carried by a record with a single IANA-style text value.

artifacts.name: RouteShape
artifacts.description: A TransitRouteSpecification is carried by a GTFSRecord with one integer routeTypeCode and is designated by exactly one Designative Name.

artifacts.name: TripShape
artifacts.description: A TrainTripSpecification is part of exactly one TransitRouteSpecification, has one Code Identifier and one Arbitrary Identifier, and is carried by a GTFSRecord with valid directionCode, isPeakService and headsignText.

artifacts.name: ScheduledStopShape
artifacts.description: A ScheduledStopSpecification is part of exactly one trip, about exactly one RailStation, carried by a record with a non-negative integer stopSequence, and has exactly one arrival and one departure Time of Day Identifier as parts.

artifacts.name: TimeOfDayShape
artifacts.description: A Time of Day Identifier is labelled arrival/departure time, is part of exactly one stop, and is carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with a raw GTFS time string (may exceed 24h) and a New York offset xsd:dateTime.

artifacts.name: duplicate_stop_sequence
artifacts.description: Two ScheduledStopSpecifications of the same trip carry the same stopSequence value.
artifacts.sparql:
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?focus a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?other a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?r1 obo:BFO_0000101 ?focus ; p6:stopSequence ?s1 .
  ?r2 obo:BFO_0000101 ?other ; p6:stopSequence ?s2 .
  FILTER(?s1 = ?s2 && STR(?focus) < STR(?other))
  BIND(CONCAT("Stop shares stopSequence ", STR(?s1), " with ", STR(?other), " in trip ", STR(?trip)) AS ?message)
}

artifacts.name: stop_station_missing
artifacts.description: A ScheduledStopSpecification is about an entity that is not declared as a p6:RailStation.

artifacts.name: trip_route_missing
artifacts.description: A TrainTripSpecification is a continuant part of an entity that is not a declared TransitRouteSpecification.

artifacts.name: arrival_after_departure
artifacts.description: The normalized arrival datetime of a stop is later than its normalized departure datetime.
artifacts.sparql:
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?focus a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification .
  ?arr a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "arrival time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?focus .
  ?dep a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "departure time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?focus .
  ?ra obo:BFO_0000101 ?arr ; cco:ont00001767 ?adt .
  ?rd obo:BFO_0000101 ?dep ; cco:ont00001767 ?ddt .
  FILTER(?adt > ?ddt)
  BIND(CONCAT("Arrival ", STR(?adt), " is after departure ", STR(?ddt)) AS ?message)
}

artifacts.name: stop_time_order_vs_sequence
artifacts.description: Within a trip, a stop with a higher stopSequence arrives before a lower-sequence stop departs.
artifacts.sparql:
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?earlier a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?focus a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?r1 obo:BFO_0000101 ?earlier ; p6:stopSequence ?s1 .
  ?r2 obo:BFO_0000101 ?focus ; p6:stopSequence ?s2 .
  ?dep a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "departure time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?earlier .
  ?arr a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "arrival time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?focus .
  ?rd obo:BFO_0000101 ?dep ; cco:ont00001767 ?ddt .
  ?ra obo:BFO_0000101 ?arr ; cco:ont00001767 ?adt .
  FILTER(?s1 < ?s2 && ?adt < ?ddt)
  BIND(CONCAT("Stop seq ", STR(?s2), " arrives at ", STR(?adt), " before stop seq ", STR(?s1), " (", STR(?earlier), ") departs at ", STR(?ddt)) AS ?message)
}

artifacts.name: time_text_format
artifacts.description: Raw GTFS time text on a Time of Day Identifier carrier is not in H:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS format.

artifacts.name: time_datetime_mismatch
artifacts.description: Normalized datetime disagrees with the raw time text (hour mod 24, minute, second) or does not use a New York UTC offset (-05:00 or -04:00).
artifacts.sparql:
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?tod a cco:ont00000827 .
  ?focus obo:BFO_0000101 ?tod ; cco:ont00001765 ?t ; cco:ont00001767 ?dt .
  FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t), "^[0-9]{1,2}:[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$"))
  BIND(xsd:integer(STRBEFORE(STR(?t), ":")) AS ?h)
  BIND(xsd:integer(STRBEFORE(STRAFTER(STR(?t), ":"), ":")) AS ?m)
  BIND(xsd:integer(STRAFTER(STRAFTER(STR(?t), ":"), ":")) AS ?s)
  BIND(?h - 24 * FLOOR(?h / 24) AS ?eh)
  FILTER(HOURS(?dt) != ?eh || MINUTES(?dt) != ?m || SECONDS(?dt) != ?s || !(TZ(?dt) IN ("-05:00", "-04:00")))
  BIND(CONCAT("Raw time '", STR(?t), "' is inconsistent with datetime ", STR(?dt), " (expected time of day and offset -05:00/-04:00)") AS ?message)
}

artifacts.name: code_list_values
artifacts.description: directionCode, wheelchairBoardingCode or routeTypeCode holds a value outside its GTFS code list or is not an integer.

artifacts.name: coordinate_range
artifacts.description: Latitude is outside -90..90, longitude is outside -180..180, or a value is not an xsd:decimal.
